senses.gloss:
Ṛcīka
------------------------------------------
Ṛcīka was a great ṛṣi (sage) endowed with special powers. He was the son of और्व and the grandson of भृगु, both of whom were also well-known.
His wife was सत्यवती, the daughter of the king Gādhi.
Pleased with her devoted service, ऋचीक once asked her to pray for any boon she liked. She requested him that a son be born to her and that her मोथेर् too should be blessed with a worthy son. ऋचीक gave both of them sanctified चरु (porridge) to be consumed, along with some special instructions. The ladies however, made a mistake and followed the instructions in the opposite order!
As a result, ऋचीक informed them that सत्यवती’s son would be a क्षत्त्रिय whereas her मोथेर् would give birth to a son who would ultimately become a ब्राह्मण.
However, on her pleading, he granted the boon that her son would be a brāh-maṇa while the grandson would become a क्षत्त्रिय.
Accordingly her son जमदग्नि remained a ब्राह्मण sage and his son, परशुराम, became a क्षत्त्रिय by temperament and actions.
Gādhi’s son was कौशिक who became विश्वामित्र (a ब्रह्मर्षि, a great ब्राह्मण-sage) by practising severe austerities.
